data.title: 黍 · 逛市场时替你挑一只甜桃
data.description: 周末市场里，黍穿大荒农业天师原作衣装，托着挑好的桃子轻轻递向你。另一只手提着布袋，神情温和又带一点肯定，像是认真选出了你会喜欢的甜度；衣袖蓝色衬里和金绳扣在摊棚下清晰可见。
data.action: 一手递出挑好的桃子，一手提着布袋
data.promptProse: Shu chooses a peach from the weekend market and offers it on her open golden hand toward the viewer, confident she has found one you will enjoy. A cloth bag hangs from her other hand rather than covering the fruit. The blue lining and gold cords of her original white jacket remain visible beneath the awning; baskets and folded stall cloths form a quiet backdrop to the thoughtful gesture.
